entry_order_investigation: Per coordinator direction, ran bun tools/allocator-lens/lens.ts 0800ebec and cross-referenced the kept GCC dump directory (0800ebec.c compiles with actual staged gcc-2.96 cc1 at -O2, confirmed by reading tools/allocator-lens/lens.ts - this is not a custom allocator, it is real GCC).
